caption: The image is a drawing of a wooden table with a rectangular top and drop-leaf sides that curve downward in a scalloped fashion. The table is rendered in shades of brown, indicating a wood finish, with darker and lighter tones used to show shading and highlights. The legs are slender and tapered, with small brass or gold-colored caps at the bottom. The table has one drawer on the right side, which is detailed with a brass or gold-colored handle. The edges of the tabletop and the frame of the table are accented with a thin gold line. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background, and is signed "Nicholas Abampora" with the date "4-22-1936" in the bottom right corner. A simple rectangular border frames the composition.
title: Table
